description: Source code for NinjaActionTargetWriter class, responsible for generating Ninja build rules for action targets in a build system.

classes.name: NinjaActionTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing Ninja build rules for action targets.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Generates Ninja build rules for the target, including dependencies, outputs, and command invocation.

methods.name: WriteRuleDefinition
methods.description: Creates a unique Ninja rule definition for the action, including command, response files, and description.

methods.name: WriteSourceRules
methods.description: Writes build rules for each source file when the target is an ACTION_FOREACH type.

methods.name: WriteOutputFilesForBuildLine
methods.description: Writes output file entries for a build line based on source files.

methods.name: WriteDepfile
methods.description: Writes depfile information for the target if specified.

methods.name: WriteNinjaVariablesForAction
methods.description: Writes additional Ninja variables related to the action's arguments and compiler settings.
